Question ID: GEO_U06_L07_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.CGM.11

A plane slices a rectangular prism parallel to its base. What cross-section is expected?

feedback.text: A rectangular prism does not have circular bases.
The slice parallel to a rectangular base forms a rectangle.
A parabola is a conic section.
A cross-section is two-dimensional, not a sphere.

Question ID: GEO_U06_L07_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.CGM.12

Which solid is formed by rotating a right triangle around one leg?

feedback.text: A cylinder comes from rotating a rectangle.
A sphere comes from rotating a semicircle.
A cube is not created by this rotation.
The other leg sweeps out the radius of a cone.
